children: Singapore's Aster Chemicals and Energy ran its naphtha-fed cracker at a rate ranging from 75% to 80% in the last five months and plans to ramp up utilisation rates further, a company official said on Thursday.
Aster, a joint venture of Indonesia's Chandra Asri and trading major Glencore, operates a 1.1-million-metric-ton-per-year steam cracker on Singapore's Bukom Island.

"We will ramp up further and we are starting to supply petrochemicals to our buyers," Andre Khor, chief financial officer and deputy chief executive officer at Aster, told Reuters on the sidelines of the APPEC conference.
